risk_note: DSX-48d H5 transitions (feel plan ⑦, orchestrator D10-1032; 规划/03 §10.6). Dialog and Sheet enter with CSS transitions and @starting-style (Dialog fade + slight scale, Sheet slide up, scrim fade; emphasized-enter), exit is timer-driven: in the same commit the modal gets aria-hidden + inert, drops its handlers and returns focus (again in the layout phase so React's end-of-commit restore cannot pull it back to the title), and a timer of motionDurationEmphasizedMs removes it, with the last rendered content kept during the exit (round 3); exit uses the normal duration and emphasized-exit. Toast fades out from durationMs minus normal. The find-order tab panels and the claim form / claim records content fade in when they appear, including content that arrives after the panel (round 2). Durations and easings only from var(--motion-*) or @couli/ui-tokens named constants; opacity and transform only; reduced motion fades only on --motion-reduced-fade. Frozen tests unchanged, including the sheet position and find-order badge cases flagged as possible conflicts. Bundle: every App route grows by at most 227 B (limit 3 KiB), all within 150 KiB. Rule tests by an independent Claude in three rounds (round 3 only made test options inline object literals and removed describe() from motion-kit after CI test-guard flagged them; the branch was rebuilt with the three implementation commits replayed on top); Codex spec-test review r1 fail (S1 bundle baseline covered only 8 files) -> r2 pass; red on the local container (19 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds; host H5 jsdom rule tests (785) and h5 unit tests (97) green; local container browser run browser-5 green for every H5 case (later runs disconnected under host load around 50; admin-only timeouts in files this task did not touch), CI runs full verification. Codex general review: r1 fail (S1 content swapped in after the panel cut in, fixed in r2), r2 pass (S2-1 content cleared before the exit, fixed in r3; S2-2 logged as a follow-up), r3 Codex verdict fail with one S1 (Sheet panel slides without fading, index.css:115) on code the r3 increment did not touch; per REVIEW.md §5.4 the orchestrator downgraded it to S2 (ruling D10-1141), so no S0/S1 stays open; the Sheet panel fade goes to the follow-up task DSX-48e. Non-funds. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex general: r1 fail (S1 fixed in r2), r2 pass (S2-1 fixed in r3), r3 Codex verdict fail with one S1 on code the r3 increment did not touch (Sheet panel opacity, apps/h5/src/shared/styles/index.css:115); per REVIEW.md §5.4 downgraded to S2 by the orchestrator, ruling D10-1141; follow-up DSX-48e
